d: Mexico has announced the capture of Fausto Isidro Meza, better known as ‘Chapo Isidro’, one of the FBI’s most-wanted drug trafficking suspects. Mexican special forces arrested the 44-year-old during an operation in Sinaloa, reportedly carried out in coordination with US intelligence. The raid triggered a fierce gun battle between security forces and cartel members, leaving four soldiers and seven suspected gunmen dead.
